purpose: Curriculum-ordered training manifest for the lathe wizard system. Ingests notable lathe machining data from easiest (single-page lookup tables) to most complex (full vendor catalogs + cross-domain CNC textbooks). Each stage is a training tier: master stage N before advancing to stage N+1.

stages.label: FOUNDATIONS — ISO codes + insert geometry decode
stages.training_objective: Map (material → ISO group) + (shape → ANSI insert code) + (use → operation type). No physics, no parameters — pure taxonomy.

tasks: operator says '316 stainless'  → AI emits 'ISO M (austenitic stainless steel, 10.5% Cr min)'
operator says 'CNMG'           → AI emits 'C geometry (rhombic 80°), general roughing + facing'
operator says 'OD finishing'   → AI emits 'tool_type=od_finish, prefer DNMG/VBMT/RCMT insert'
training_targets.kpi: 100% accuracy on ISO-group classification + insert-code decode

stages.label: VENDOR DATASHEETS — single-grade application notes
stages.training_objective: For a given grade code (e.g. AH725, KCP25, WPP20G), retrieve vendor's coating type, recommended ISO ranges, and a 1-2 sentence application note.

tasks: operator pastes 'CNMG 432-KM AH725' → AI emits 'Tungaloy AH725: PVD multilayer, ISO P20-P30/M10-M20/S, industry-favorite stainless champion'
operator asks 'best grade for hardened steel 50 HRC'  → AI emits 'TB610 (Ingersoll CBN), TB670 for severe interrupt, TK1001 (Seco) for 40-45 HRC range'
training_targets.kpi: 85% accuracy on grade-code lookup + correct ISO range identification

stages.label: VENDOR GRADE-SERIES SYSTEMS — multi-grade lineups
stages.training_objective: Understand grade families (Sumitomo AC8000P vs AC5000S, Seco Duratomic TP vs TK, Walter Tiger-tec Silver vs Gold) and pick the right family by application class before drilling to a specific grade.

tasks: operator asks 'Inconel 718 finishing'                  → AI emits 'Sumitomo AC5005S (lightest finish), or Tungaloy AH725, or Kennametal KCS10'
operator asks 'general steel turning, balanced grade'  → AI emits 'GC4425, KCP25C, TP2500, UE6020 — pick by vendor availability'
training_targets.kpi: Family-level recommendation reaches first_choice in wizard_query_records 80%+ of the time

stages.label: FULL VENDOR CATALOGS — comprehensive multi-system
stages.training_objective: Cross-reference geometry × grade × chipformer × ISO group × workpiece condition. Pick optimal insert when operator specifies all constraints.

tasks: operator says '17-4 PH stainless H1025, OD rough with light interrupt, 25 HRC, 2mm DOC, 0.2 mm/rev feed' → AI returns top-3 insert recommendations across vendors with citations

stages.label: TURNING PROGRAMMING + G-CODE CANNED CYCLES
stages.training_objective: Generate Fanuc/Okuma/Haas-compatible lathe programs using G71/G72/G73/G76 canned cycles, G96/G97 spindle modes, G50 RPM caps. Handle controls lacking G71 via tribal IF/GOTO trick.

tasks: operator says 'rough OD from 50mm to 40mm, leave 0.3mm radial finish stock, Fanuc 0i'              → AI emits G71 U0.5 R1 / G71 P10 Q20 U0.3 W0.1 F0.25 + N-block contour from largest-OD-in rule
operator says 'same job, on a Haas SL-10 that doesn't have G71'                                     → AI emits IF/GOTO Poor-Man's G71 loop (per CNCCookbook tribal trick)
training_targets.kpi: Generated program runs on simulator with zero alarms; cycle time within 10% of reference

stages.label: FULL PRINT-TO-PROGRAM — cross-domain integration
stages.training_objective: From blueprint → fixture plan → tool selection → speed/feed → program → first-part validation. The full lathe pipeline whiskey owns (JM-DIE-LATHE-UPGRADE-MS0).

tasks: operator uploads a drawing PDF → pipeline returns fixtured-plan + program + cost-estimate
training_targets.kpi: First-part pass rate ≥85% across the JM-Die archive baseline (15,251 .MIN files)

training_recipe.phase_1_supervised: Run stages 0-2 through LatheAITrainingEngine as VALIDATION priors. Every JM-Die .MIN program parsed gets checked against grades_by_iso_p (etc.) and wizard_query_records — flag deviations as ValidationIssue with vendor URL citation.
training_recipe.phase_2_active_learn: Feed stage 3-4 content into LatheActiveLearningEngine. Operator confirms/rejects AI suggestions; corrections weight the next round's priors.
training_recipe.phase_3_print_to_program: Run stages 4-5 against new JM-Die jobs end-to-end via the LathePrintToProgram* engine chain. Compare AI-generated program vs operator's program; learn from delta.

iscar_grade_chart.axis_organization: Harder ↔ Tougher (vertical) × ISO P/M/K/N/S/H (horizontal) — exactly the wizard-decision-axis the master index encodes
iscar_grade_chart.training_value: single-page reference — operator can paste a code and AI returns vendor + application range immediately

next_units.scope: Extend pdf-parse-extract to emit page-anchored tribal atoms (page#, section, table-row triples). Currently we extract concatenated text + headings — per-page granularity needs PDFParse v2 API research.
